title: Task progress follows owned worker writes and restores offline
description: Use the isolated one-slot CLI fixture selected by FARMSLOT_OFFLINE_PROOF=1, FARMSLOT_DISABLE_ORCHESTRATION=1, FARMSLOT_HOME, FARMSLOT_ROOT, FARMSLOT_RUNS_DIR, FARMSLOT_PROJECTS_DIR, FARMSLOT_SLOT_RESOURCE_PROOF, FARMSLOT_GATEWAY_PROFILE, FARMSLOT_CDP_PORT, FARMSLOT_UI_URL and FARMSLOT_RUN_WEB_EVIDENCE_DIR. Keep FARMSLOT_MONITOR_FLEET_POLL_MS=600000 and run with a surviving owned gateway tsx watcher. Setup seeds one owned monitoring run and its slot binding while the gateway is stopped; no worker or model starts. Real file edits and a corrupt child registry reach the production task watcher and actual run-list checklist row. No UI/cache values are injected. Finally restore exact status bytes/permissions and remove the owned run/task directory. Native progress and remaining views require their own acceptance.

proofTargets.claim: Disconnect preserves the saved checklist and its visible read failure until a successful current read replaces it.
Missing runs fail closed and reused slots preserve old worker, reviewer and selected-step progress without exposing successor bytes.
An actual owned worker checklist edit updates the canonical run row with a newer progress stamp.
A malformed child registry leaves saved counts with a visible read error, then recovers through its owning watcher.
Cold offline startup renders saved checklist counts and age; gateway restart refreshes them before readiness returns.
Observed checklist and acceptance-sidecar removals and recreation reach the canonical progress row without another write or Refresh.

prove.intent: Use one owned scratch worker and real filesystem watchers, then restore exact status bytes and remove every owned fixture.

progressNotified.intent: An actual owned worker checklist edit updates the canonical run row with a newer progress stamp.

progressFailureVisible.intent: A malformed child registry leaves saved counts with a visible read error, then recovers through its owning watcher.

coldProgressRestored.intent: Cold offline startup renders saved checklist counts and age; gateway restart refreshes them before readiness returns.

progressErrorRetained.intent: Disconnect after a real failed progress projection and verify that saved counts and the read error remain visible.

progressOwnershipIsolated.intent: Read missing, retired and successor runs through the real gateway, including retained role and selected-step artifacts.

progressSourceRemovals.intent: Observed checklist and acceptance-sidecar removals and recreation reach the canonical progress row without another write or Refresh.
